name: io.phishdestroy/cti
title: PhishDestroy CTI
description: Read-only phishing-domain intelligence: check domains, dated evidence reports, search by brand.

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Return current PhishDestroy report-database counters with metric definitions and source timestamps.

tools.name: get_cti_stats
tools.description: Return CTI aggregates. Confirmed takedowns and latest-check unavailability are separate fields.

tools.name: get_domain_report
tools.description: Return the stored evidence record for one domain, including dated detections and report links. With detail (summary, evidence or full), sections, max_chars or cursor it returns the compact phishdestroy.domain-report.v1 structure instead: record status (listed, not_found, removed, withdrawn), the PhishDestroy assessment apart from third-party verdicts, dated availability with conflicts, confirmed takedown, evidence links and paged observations. Without these arguments the original record is returned unchanged.

domain.description: Domain name without a path (Unicode names are accepted with the compact arguments).

detail.description: Compact report depth. summary: status, assessment, verdicts, availability, takedown, links. evidence: adds registration and paged observations. full: adds machine-generated analysis and untrusted page text.

sections.description: Only these sections (record is the status, page_content is untrusted text from the site).

max_chars.description: Upper bound for the JSON size; pages are shortened and optional sections dropped first, with truncated, omitted_sections and continue in the answer.

tools.name: lookup_domains
tools.description: Check up to 25 domains in one call: record status per domain (listed, not_found, removed, withdrawn) with the report URL, first-recorded time and confirmed takedown. not_found is not a safety verdict. Unicode names, URLs and defanged [.] input are normalised; invalid entries are listed separately. For evidence call get_domain_report with detail summary.

domains.description: Domain names (URLs are accepted; only the host is used).

tools.name: probe_domain
tools.description: Run a rate-limited live HTTP probe for a public domain. The result is liveness evidence, not a safety verdict.

domain.description: Public domain name without a path.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search published PhishDestroy domain reports by a domain (exact; URLs and defanged input accepted), the start of a domain name (3+ characters) or an impersonated brand as stored (e.g. Coinbase, MetaMask). Returns up to 20 results (id = domain, title with the first-recorded date, url = report page), newest brand matches first. Read one with fetch. An empty result is not a safety verdict.

query.description: Domain, start of a domain name, or brand name.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one PhishDestroy domain report found with search (id = domain): record status, assessment, third-party verdicts with dates, availability, takedown and evidence links, as text and JSON (phishdestroy.domain-report.v1, detail summary).

id.description: The id of a search result (a domain).
